I'll stay silent this round.

Given the reverse auction mechanics (lowest bid wins, paid at second-lowest), posting a message could strategically inform competitors about my cost of capital or bidding intentions, which would only help them outbid me. My cost of 0.1117 is already quite competitive based on last round's results (0.1126 cleared). 

Remaining silent preserves my informational advantage and lets me bid strategically without telegraphing my position.
